text.en:
21st. SEPTEMBERI 2017 No. S 74

MARITIME AND PORT AUTHORITY OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM ORDER, 2017 (S 22 / 2017 〕 Notification Of commencement ln exercise of the power conferred by section 刂 刂 of the Maritime and Port Authority of Brunei Darussalam Order 2017 , the Minister of Conununications, with the approval of His Majesly the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 28th September 2017 as the date on which that Order shall commence. Dated this 29th. day of Zulhijjah, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 21st. day of September, 2017 ·

DATO SERI SETIA AWANG HAJI MUSTAPPA

BIN HAJI SIRAT Minister Of Conmumications, Brunei Darussalam. 5103
